name: Osric Strang
summary: In Stormwind's Old Town, veteran armor merchant Osric Strang supplies weary travelers and Alliance defenders with sturdy gear. His shop, Limited Immunity, specializes in heavy mail and plate armor, along with shields.

sections.title: Shopkeeper of Limited Immunity
sections.body: Osric Strang runs Limited Immunity, where fighters find heavy armor and shields. He also helps arriving couriers who need a point of contact in the capital, including those coming from nearby settlements such as Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

faq.answer: Osric sells heavy protective armor, including augmented chain, polished scale, solid platemail suits, bucklers, and heater shields.

faq.q: Where can I find Osric Strang?
faq.answer: You can find Osric inside Limited Immunity, an armor shop in Old Town near Stormwind's southern district.

faq.q: Why am I sent to Osric Strang on a quest?
faq.answer: Couriers carrying goods across the kingdom, including shipments arriving by gryphon master from Westfall, are directed to Osric's shop in Old Town to deliver them and receive return messages.

angles.text: As a warrior visiting Old Town, you can find reliable chain, scale, plate, and shields from Osric, offering dependable bulk protection.
As an Alliance member, you can rely on Stormwind resident Osric to equip the kingdom's defenders and help couriers maintain supply links between Stormwind and outlying settlements.
